message.content: {"query":"MATCH (c:Feature {name:'LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)'}) WITH collect(c.name) AS anchor WITH ['Conditional Handover (CHO, Rel-16)','Conditional PSCell Change (CPC, Rel-16)','Conditional PSCell Addition/Change (CPAC, Rel-18)'] AS catalogDisjoint OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Feature {name:'LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)'})-[:disjointWith]-(g:Feature) WITH catalogDisjoint, collect(DISTINCT g.name) AS graphDisjoint RETURN (all(x IN catalogDisjoint WHERE x IN graphDisjoint) AND all(y IN graphDisjoint WHERE y IN catalogDisjoint)) AS matchesCatalog","abstain":false}
